# Open ReverseLab — AI reverse engineering workspace

> 334 knowledge-base articles for reverse engineering and defensive analysis, with desktop and MCP integrations.
> Desktop workspaces with red / blue / both strategies, parallel Goals, execution evidence and a searchable knowledge base.
